message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day battles of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly:

| Side | Casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|----------------------------------------|
| French (and allied German contingents) | ~25 000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch‑Belgian‑Prussian coalition | ~23 000 |

So in total about **48 000** soldiers were killed, wounded or taken prisoner/missing on that day.  These figures are estimates based on contemporary reports and later historical research; exact numbers vary slightly among sources.

The Battle of Waterloo (1815) had casualties: French ~25,000, Allied ~23,000. But we can give total casualties. Provide approximate numbers. No tool needed.
